issue.empty: A workflow needs at least one step.
issue.badId: Step id "{id}" must be lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
issue.unknownTarget: Step "{id}" points at "{target}", which does not exist.
issue.missingPrompt: An AI step needs a prompt.
issue.producesNeedsCategory: A producing step must name the category of the pages it creates.
issue.deadEnd: This step produces nothing and leads nowhere.
issue.fanOutIgnored: Only ai.generate steps fan out; this step will produce a single node.
issue.noEntry: Every step is pointed at by another — the workflow has no entry step.
issue.manyEntries: The workflow has several entry steps; all of them start when a run begins.
